blocks.text: useFetch can load data and give the page loading and error state. A file in public can act as simple build-time content.
Use a Nuxt 3 project for these file paths. Examples go in the files named in comments. Remove the starter welcome screen and use NuxtPage in app.vue. Nuxt code needs its own build tool.

items: `v-if` creates its content when the rule is true. A neighbouring `v-else` gives the alternate content.
`useFetch` prepares a data result together with loading and error information. Handle its error state as well as its data.

blocks.text: With the real JSON file present, the page shows Moon Trip. A failure has its own message.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Create the file and use its root URL, /book.json. Do not treat public files as secret.
